svg.text: Amdahl sensitivity: a Phase-6 win has a bounded full-K2 impact
Analytical model only; measured V128 direct-swap points are slower than 1.0x
Full-K2 speedup = 1 / ((1 - phase share) + phase share / Phase-6 speedup)
Model source: exact static HMMA atom count (Phase 6 = 128, K2 total = 416). Markers use Job 17937 V128 L0 inner=64 measurements.
